description:
About our brand and products: 


Dr. Heff’s are dental supplements developed by UK dentists to enhance oral care routines. Their unique formulation helps to look after mouth and teeth health, whilst freshening breath and being easy to fit into daily life. 


Perfect for anyone trying to improve their oral health, relieve dry mouth, or choose a healthier option. 


Currently available in mint flavour, with more flavours coming soon, they are used the same as a regular mint. We recommend around 5 a day, whenever convenient between meals, snacks, and acidic drinks. 


The highlights of Dr. Heff’s:


  • We’re a UK created brand, our supplements have been scientifically developed by dentists with the aim of making oral health easier for their patients. 

  • Our supplements promote a healthier oral microbiome, remineralise enamel, and neutralise pH levels in the mouth. 

  • Our supplements relieve dry mouth, making them perfect for anyone going through menopause, experiencing medication side effects, or going through treatment. 

  • Our supplements are sugar-free, vegan, and contain natural ingredients.


Our affiliate offer:


  • Receive a 10% commission on total sales when a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your coupon code - or a 15% commission for customers who are new to our site. 

  • Receive a 20% commission when a customer purchases our 6 tub quarterly subscription through your affiliate link or uses your coupon code. *Valid only on new subscription customers, and commission valid on first subscription payment only. 

  • Receive a custom coupon code to provide your audience with 15% off their next purchase. *Valid for one order per person.

  • Commission payments are made on the last working day of the following calendar month.

Last Updated: 02/06/2026

Welcome to the Dr Heff's Affiliate Program (the "Program"). The Program is operated by Functional Oral Health Limited trading as Dr Heff's ("Dr Heff's", "we", "us" or "our").

If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions, you must not participate in the Program.

1. Definitions

For the purposes of these Terms:

  • Affiliate Link means the unique referral link assigned to an Affiliate through the Program.

  • Commission means the compensation payable to an Affiliate in accordance with the applicable commission structure.

  • Dashboard means the Affiliate account area provided through the UpPromote platform.

  • Program means the Dr Heff's Affiliate Program.

2. Affiliate Application and Approval

Participation in the Program is subject to approval by Dr Heff's.

As a condition of participation in the Program, Affiliates agree to the self-billing arrangements set out in these Terms and Conditions. 

3. Affiliate Links and Referral Attribution

Approved Affiliates will receive a unique Affiliate Link and may also be assigned a promotional coupon code.

Commissions are attributed according to the tracking and attribution rules configured within the Program and displayed in the Affiliate Dashboard.

Where a Customer clicks multiple affiliate links, attribution will generally be awarded according to the Program's tracking rules at the time of purchase.

If a Customer both uses an Affiliate Link and an Affiliate coupon code, only a single commission will be payable in respect of that transaction.

Affiliates must not alter, manipulate or attempt to interfere with tracking functionality.

Dr Heff's reserves the right to determine eligibility for commissions where tracking discrepancies arise.

4. Marketing Requirements

Affiliates may promote Dr Heff's through approved online channels including websites, blogs, email newsletters and social media platforms.

Affiliates must not:

  • make false, misleading or deceptive statements regarding Dr Heff's or its products;

  • make medical, clinical, therapeutic or health claims that have not been expressly approved by Dr Heff's;

  • engage in spam marketing, unsolicited commercial communications or other unlawful promotional activity;

  • use bots, automated traffic, click farms or other artificial methods to generate referrals;

  • engage in cookie stuffing or any attempt to manipulate tracking systems;

  • impersonate Dr Heff's or represent themselves as employees or agents of Dr Heff's;

  • create websites, social media accounts or domain names that are likely to confuse consumers into believing they are operated by Dr Heff's;

  • bid on Dr Heff's trademarks or brand names in paid search advertising without prior written consent;

Affiliates may only use promotional materials approved or supplied by Dr Heff's.

Affiliates are responsible for ensuring that all promotional activity complies with applicable laws, regulations and advertising standards.

Affiliates must clearly disclose their commercial relationship with Dr Heff's whenever required by applicable law or advertising guidance.

Examples of acceptable disclosures may include:

Affiliates are solely responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable advertising and consumer protection laws.

6. Commission Structure and Payments

Commission rates, payment schedules and eligibility criteria are set out within the Affiliate Dashboard, Affiliate Guide or other Program documentation.

Commissions are calculated based on the net order value excluding taxes, shipping fees, duties, discounts and other excluded charges unless otherwise stated.

To receive payment, Affiliates must provide accurate payment details through the Dashboard.

Commissions are only payable on completed and verified transactions.

Dr Heff's reserves the right to review and validate all referral transactions before approving commissions.

Affiliates are solely responsible for all taxes arising from commission payments. Where applicable, VAT shall be dealt with in accordance with Section 7 [VAT]. 

7. VAT and Self-Billing

Affiliates are responsible for determining and complying with their own tax obligations.

Affiliates who are registered for Value Added Tax (VAT) must notify Dr Heff's and provide a valid VAT registration number together with any information reasonably requested to verify their VAT status.

By joining the Program and accepting these Terms, the Affiliate agrees that Dr Heff's may operate a self-billing arrangement in respect of commission payments. Under this arrangement, Dr Heff's will prepare self-billed invoices on behalf of the Affiliate for commissions due under the Program.

Where an Affiliate is VAT registered and VAT is properly chargeable on the services supplied to Dr Heff's, commissions shall be paid together with any applicable VAT. The applicable VAT amount will be shown on the self-billed invoice generated by Dr Heff's.

The Affiliate agrees not to issue separate VAT invoices to Dr Heff's in respect of commissions covered by the self-billing arrangement.

The Affiliate must promptly notify Dr Heff's if:

  • its VAT registration number changes;

  • it becomes VAT registered;

  • it ceases to be VAT registered; or

  • there is any other change affecting the VAT treatment of commissions payable under the Program.

Dr Heff's reserves the right to withhold any VAT element of a payment until satisfactory evidence of VAT registration has been provided.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, all commission rates published by Dr Heff's are exclusive of VAT.

VAT will only be paid where applicable under the relevant VAT legislation.

8. Refunds, Chargebacks and Commission Reversals

No commission will be payable on transactions that are cancelled, refunded, charged back or determined to be fraudulent.

Where a commission has already been credited or paid in respect of such a transaction, Dr Heff's may deduct the relevant amount from future commission payments or require repayment.

Dr Heff's reserves the right to withhold commissions while investigating suspected fraud, abuse or violations of these Terms.

9. Network Commissions

Where enabled within the Program, Affiliates may invite other individuals to apply to become Affiliates using their network referral link.

Any network commissions will be calculated and paid in accordance with the commission structure displayed in the Dashboard.

Network commissions are earned solely from qualifying product sales and not from the act of recruiting Affiliates.

Dr Heff's reserves the right to modify or discontinue any network commission structure at any time.

10. Cookies and Tracking

Dr Heff's uses cookies and other tracking technologies to attribute referrals.

The applicable cookie duration is stated within the Affiliate registration process or Dashboard.

Where tracking is unavailable due to browser settings, cookie deletion, ad blockers, privacy tools, technical failures or other factors beyond our control, commissions may not be recorded.

Dr Heff's does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free tracking and shall not be liable for commissions not recorded due to technical issues.

12. Data Protection

Affiliates shall comply with all applicable data protection and privacy laws, including the UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018 where applicable.

Affiliates must not collect, process or share personal data relating to Customers except as permitted by law.

13. Termination

An Affiliate may terminate participation in the Program at any time by contacting affiliates@drheffs.com.

Dr Heff's may suspend or terminate an Affiliate's participation immediately and without notice where:

Upon termination, the Affiliate must immediately cease all promotion of Dr Heff's and remove all Dr Heff's marketing materials from their channels.

16. Changes to the Program

Dr Heff's reserves the right to amend these Terms, the commission structure, cookie duration, payment schedule or any aspect of the Program at any time.

Updated Terms will be made available through the Website, Dashboard or other appropriate communication channels.
